user.title: Enroll this hub with Oasira Care
user.description: In Oasira Care, open Facility & Device Management and create an enrollment code for this hub. Codes are single-use and expire.

data_description.api_url: Base URL of the Oasira Care API, without /v1.
data_description.node_name: Shown in Oasira Care so you can tell hubs apart.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enroll this hub
reauth_confirm.description: This hub's access to {facility} ({node}) was revoked or lost. Enter a new enrollment code for the same facility.

error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL including the http or https scheme
error.invalid_code: The enrollment code is invalid, expired or already used.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Oasira Care API. Check the URL and network.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.

abort.wrong_facility: That code belongs to a different facility than this hub.
abort.legacy_entry: This entry used the old account sign-in. Remove it and add the integration again with an enrollment code.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one hub can be enrolled per Home Assistant instance. Remove the existing entry first.

add_label_to_entity.name: Add label to entity
add_label_to_entity.description: Add a label to an entity

update_entity.name: Update entity
update_entity.description: Update an entity in the entity registry with an area

set_in_bed_state.name: Set in-bed state
set_in_bed_state.description: Update the in-bed binary sensor for an area

send_event.name: Send Care event
send_event.description: Send a custom event to the Oasira Care API (telemetry for most types, alerts for safety types).

init.title: Oasira Options
init.description: Tune presence streaming to the Oasira Care API. Updates are only sent when a state changes, so the hub stays quiet. Raise a no-movement alert after a quiet period, and set how often unchanged areas are refreshed.

data_description.no_movement_minutes: Raise one no-movement alert per area after this much quiet time. Auto-resolves on next motion.
data_description.summary_interval_minutes: How often an area whose state did not change is re-sent, so Care keeps a heartbeat. Set to 0 to only send on state changes.

error.care_api_incomplete: Enter both the Care API URL and the ingest key, or leave both empty.
error.invalid_url: URL must include the http or https scheme
error.invalid_no_movement: No-movement threshold must be 5 to 1440 minutes.
error.invalid_summary: The refresh interval must be 0 (only on change) to 1440 minutes.
